text:
sara: Heads up — customer 'OrchidHealth' says their firewall logs show intermittent blocks to our inference edge.
jamal: any error samples?
sara: They get 403-ish application-level denies when calling our API through their corporate proxy. They pasted: "connection reset by peer", plus our IP in logs: 35.203.112.45
kevin: that IP is from our EU-NAT pool? run `dig +short myip.opendns.com @resolver1.opendns.com` from the node to confirm
maria: also ask customer if they're whitelisting by FQDN or ip; often corp proxies block by port or preserve source-port = false
sara: customer's reply: they whitelist a /24 but seeing rotates every 6h; they mention a managed proxy chain to their cloud provider
ops-bot: Deploy notice: natpool-rls rotated 35.203.112.0/28 -> 35.203.112.32/28 (2026-03-08T09:12Z)
jamal: ah — we've got scheduled ephemeral nat rotation to balance SNAT ports across racks. Shouldn't be rotating public prefixes so frequently though
kevin: we're rotating internal SNAT ranges, but LB egress EIPs shouldn't change. Need to check if customers are hitting our outbound via shared egress IPs from GCP egress service
maria: debug steps for customer —
```
# have the customer run from their proxy
curl -x http://proxy.example.com:8080 -sS https://ifconfig.me
# and from a VM behind the same chain
curl -s https://ifconfig.me
```
sara: they ran it — one returns 35.203.112.45, another 34.87.201.9. rotation between steps
jamal: if they're behind a proxy chain that performs additional SNAT, their allowlist needs to include all possible egress IPs (our documented egress set + provider-managed proxies). For managed proxies the provider may advertise a changing pool.
kevin: product note — we should add a short FAQ: "Why do my egress IPs change?" and include guidance for customers using corporate proxies and preserve-source-port issues
maria: practical mitigation options:
- use TLS SNI allowlisting to avoid IP churn (customers can allow by SNI if proxy supports passthrough)
- ask customer to whitelist the full published egress CIDR + known cloud provider outbound ranges
- recommend VPN/VPC peering or Private deployment for stable IPs
sara: customer asks whether we offer static egress for Hosted API — we do via Redwood Dedicated or static-egress add-on. I'll share link
network-oncall: follow-up: I'll open an internal ticket to validate the natpool rotation job and add an audit log entry so ops rotations are announced in #infra-updates
sara: thanks — forwarding mitigation steps to customer. :white_check_mark:
